headline: Motilal Oswal sees limited upside for Torrent Power despite massive capex plan
hook: Heavy capex meets a modest return target
summary: Motilal Oswal has maintained a cautious stance on Torrent Power even as the company embarks on a massive Rs 37,700 crore capital expenditure push. The brokerage highlights that current valuations already factor in much of the growth, leaving limited upside of around 4% for investors. Torrent Power plans to deploy these funds across its distribution, generation, and renewable energy segments. Indian retail investors holding the stock should weigh the heavy capital outlays against the constrained near-term stock price appreciation projected by analysts.
